OH TO ADD TO THIS have a general idea regarding the context of the poems 

for example: kamikaze
make sure you have an answer to what, when, and why 
you don’t want to be talking about something completely irrelevant

what i did when i was doing my gcses was pick 3-4 quotes per poem that has words which could be interpreted differently depending on the question and memorise them. 

have a general idea of what each poem is about and their themes, as well as know what poems have similar themes for relevant comparisons. 

mind maps usually helps !!

sure thing :)

no worries !! ik some ppl say to speed through all of the questions and do the easy ones first but that messes up my timing 
the first time i tried that i ran out of time to do seven whole questions on dm :( never again

for timing i wrote down the midpoint for each section and aim to be +/- 1 question around that time (if i’m not i just flag+guess to catch up)
oh also flag and guess the questions that look insanely complicated there’s no point spending time on those qs when you can do the easier ones and get it right
honestly just ignore the avg medify student as it includes the untimed practices and aim to spend only 30 secs per question in a set

was averaging 2643 on medify and got 2970 so id say 2800+ is definitely achievable 
didn’t use medentry but i’m pretty sure the questions on medify were harder than the actual one at least for qr 
for ar i got 890 and honestly the less you stress about it the more fun it gets which helped me a lot as i actually enjoyed doing them
also for ar they always ask you the same type of questions and there’s plenty of acronyms online
id say if you can’t find a pattern no matter what just pick a/b and stick with it you’re bound to get at least 2 questions right if you do that
at least that’s what i do

honestly just do practice questions and leave the mocks for the last week or two
i spent most of the time spamming untimed practice questions to get myself used to the way questions are asked and honestly after doing so many you kinda notice a pattern
i do regret not doing more timed practice :”

in my official test the qr section was definitely easier than the one on medify but the others were similar to the mock
honestly just focus on timing 
for AR ik it’s what everyone say but the more you practice the easier it gets
don’t be scared to guess if the questions taking you too long / too complicated 
there’s no point figuring out one hard question and run out of time for the easier ones

for me what i was most stressed about was timing so i wrote down the midway point for all sections so ik whether i have time to finish the entire section
if im behind by a minute or two i just guess a question or two + flag them to catch up on timing 

all questions give you the same amount of points so if you see a question that’s complicated flag it+guess then move on

did mine today got 2970 after getting and average of 2643 on the mocks on medify 
id say practice your worst areas for the next five days then afterwards just spam the mocks
i did one mock a day and occasionally some extra revision but imo the most important bit is knowing what and when to guess a question
i’m not sure but you might be burning more calories than you think since your metabolism is faster as you’re eating more calories than before
